title: AutoQS: Automated Quantization Strategy Design with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.11975v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantization reduces LLM deployment costs, but effective strategies must balance model quality and storage. LLM-driven search can automate strategy design through repeated proposal and evaluation. This process must identify useful strategies within a limited evaluation budget. The key challenge is that \textit{actual quantization is expensive, while inexpensive proxies may not reflect quantized-model performance.} To address this challenge, we present AutoQS, an \textbf{Auto}mated \textbf{Q}uantization \textbf{S}trategy Design with LLMs. AutoQS keeps weight precision fixed and searches group-size allocations across layers and operators under deployment constraints. Evaluation history guides coordinated LLM proposals, while deterministic validation ensures compatible allocations. translated_title: AutoQS：基于大语言模型的自动化量化策略设计
translated_abstract: 量化可以降低大语言模型的部署成本，但有效的量化策略必须在模型质量与存储开销之间取得平衡。由大语言模型驱动的搜索可以通过反复的提案与评估来自动化策略设计，而这一过程需要在有限的评估预算内识别出有用的策略。关键挑战在于：实际的量化操作代价高昂，而廉价的代理方法可能无法真实反映量化后模型的性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了AutoQS——一种基于大语言模型的自动化量化策略设计方法。AutoQS保持权重精度固定，在部署约束下搜索跨层和跨算子的分组大小分配方案。评估历史引导大语言模型进行协同提案，同时确定性验证确保分配方案的兼容性。一种低成本的模型质量代理方法用于评估候选方案，候选方案库则保留备选分配方案以指导后续提案，并定期进行实际[评估验证]。
tldr: AutoQS提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的自动化量化策略设计框架，通过低成本质量代理评估、评估历史引导的协同提案和候选方案库，在有限评估预算内自动搜索满足部署约束的跨层分组大小分配方案，兼顾模型质量与存储开销。
en_tdlr: AutoQS is an LLM-driven framework that automatically designs quantization strategies by searching group-size allocations across layers under deployment constraints, using inexpensive quality proxies, history-guided LLM proposals, and a candidate repository to find effective strategies within a limited evaluation budget.
